title: A simpler, smarter store
lead: Dukani makes product entry, sales, inventory, credit and orders simple. Customers can see all their purchases in one place.
featuresTitle: From product entry to settling credit
featuresLead: Core workflows keep things clear and require minimal data entry.
quickSaleText: Scan a barcode or search inventory, choose payment and send an invoice link.
inventoryText: Reuse existing products, replenish stock and receive low stock alerts.
ordersText: In-store pickup or store delivery with order tracking.
sellerText: Manage products, sales, credit, orders and reports in Dukani’s green workspace.
buyerText: View purchases, invoices and debts, and track orders in the indigo workspace.
trustTitle: Clear finances, with the store in control
trustText: Order approval, receipt verification and manual settlements are finalized by the seller.
tagline: Dukani · For every Iranian seller and buyer
